{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Prosperity ''''' was a [[Fondor/Legends|Fondorian]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] that participated in the [[Second Battle of Fondor]]''.

After the surrender of the Fondorian forces, [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] decided to press on the attack and the ''Prosperity'' took a direct hit to her bridge from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']].
